canonical_statement: Provisional complex topological K-theory scope: multiplication by the complex Bott class gives the twofold periodicity isomorphism in reduced complex topological K-theory. The exact category of spaces, grading convention, Bott class, and naturality data must be selected from a pinpoint primary source before the Lean statement gate.
domain_and_universes: Open: a based compact Hausdorff space or finite CW complex X, a model of reduced complex topological K-theory, and the universes needed by that model.
quantifiers: every space X in the source-faithful category selected at the statement gate
every integer K-theory degree q, if the root is expressed as a graded cohomology theory
hypotheses: X satisfies the compactness/CW and basedness hypotheses of the selected primary formulation
the complex Bott element is represented in the selected K-theory model
conclusion: External product or multiplication by the complex Bott element induces a natural isomorphism between K-theory degrees differing by two; exact direction and suspension convention remain to be frozen.
statement_choices_requiring_source_audit: reduced versus unreduced complex topological K-theory
compact Hausdorff spaces versus finite CW complexes or compact pairs
K^(q)(X) isomorphic to K^(q+2)(X) versus a double-suspension isomorphism
multiplication by the Bott class versus an equivalent loop-space homotopy equivalence
whether naturality and multiplicativity are part of the root or composition obligations

alternate_encodings.target: the double-suspension isomorphism in reduced complex K-theory
alternate_encodings.relationship: expected equivalent formulation after grading conventions are fixed

alternate_encodings.target: the stable loop-space equivalence Omega^2 U ~= U x Z (or its connected-component form)
alternate_encodings.relationship: topological formulation underlying complex K-periodicity; not statement identity without checked representability transports

alternate_encodings.target: eightfold periodicity of real topological K-theory
alternate_encodings.relationship: excluded distinct real theorem, not an alternate encoding of the chosen complex root

excluded_degenerate_cases: Real KO eightfold periodicity, equivariant K-theory, algebraic K-theory, operator K-theory, and a bare computation of homotopy groups are not silently substituted. The point and sphere cases are boundary probes, not the whole natural theorem.
scope_nodes: BP-ROOT natural twofold complex K-theory periodicity isomorphism
BP-KMODEL selected reduced complex K-theory and suspension/product operations
BP-BOTT construction and normalization of the complex Bott element
BP-INVERT proof that Bott multiplication is an isomorphism
BP-NAT naturality in the selected category of spaces
BP-TRANSPORT equivalence with any credited suspension or loop-space formulation
